privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1.title: 1. Data Controller
privacy.s1.p1: The controller of your personal data is Szymon Gross, an individual operating the My warehouse web application available at warehouse.codefromheaven.dev (hereinafter: "Service"). Contact: szymon.gross.dev@gmail.com
privacy.s2.title: 2. What data we collect
privacy.s2.p1: In connection with using the Service, we process the following personal and application data:
privacy.s2.item1: Email address – required for account registration and sign-in
privacy.s2.item2: First and last name – provided upon registration or retrieved from your Google profile
privacy.s2.item3: Profile picture – optional, uploaded by user or retrieved from your Google profile
privacy.s2.item5: System roles & account status – assigned by administrator
privacy.s2.item7: Inventory data (warehouses, rooms, boxes, items) – names, descriptions, and locations are protected with Client-Side Encryption using AES-256-GCM. Neither the Administrator nor cloud database providers can read or decrypt your inventory contents (Zero-Knowledge architecture)
privacy.s_vault.title: 3. Zero-Knowledge Encryption & Content Privacy (Art. 32 GDPR)
privacy.s_vault.p1: The Service implements rigorous technical security measures under Art. 32 GDPR. All information regarding your stored belongings is encrypted locally in your browser before being transmitted to the cloud:
privacy.s_vault.item1: Zero Administrator Access (Zero-Knowledge) – The Service Administrator and cloud infrastructure providers (Google Cloud Firestore) store only opaque ciphertext. No one except you has the technical or physical ability to see what items you own or where they are stored.
privacy.s_vault.item2: Cryptographic Keys Under Your Sole Control – The cryptographic key (AES-256-GCM) is derived on your device using PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations of SHA-256) directly from your master credentials or 4-digit PIN. Your PIN and master key are never transmitted over the network and never stored in any database.
privacy.s_vault.item3: No Profiling or Content Scanning – Because of client-side encryption, the Service does not analyze, index, profile, or share your belongings with any third parties (including advertisers or AI models).
privacy.s_vault.p2: If you forget your password or PIN, your personal Emergency Recovery Key is the only way to recover access. The Service intentionally contains zero backdoors or master keys.
privacy.s3.title: 4. Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing
privacy.s3.p1: We process your personal data for:
privacy.s3.item1: Providing the electronic service – creating and managing your user account and storing/searching your hierarchy of warehouses, rooms, boxes, and items (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR – performance of a contract)
privacy.s3.item2: Ensuring system security and preventing abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR – legitimate interest of the controller)
privacy.s4.title: 5. Data Recipients – Data Processors
privacy.s4.p1: For technical operation of the Service, we use services provided by Google LLC and Cloudinary Ltd. (United States), specifically:
privacy.s4.item1: Firebase Authentication – identity and sign-in management (email/password and Google Sign-In)
privacy.s4.item2: Cloud Firestore – database storing profile data, settings, and warehouse/item structures
privacy.s4.item3: Cloudinary – storage and optimization of user profile pictures
privacy.s4.item4: Firebase Hosting / GitHub Pages – hosting and delivery of the web application
privacy.s4.p2: Data transfer to the USA takes place on the basis of Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission. Google's privacy policy is available at: policies.google.com/privacy, and Cloudinary's privacy policy is available at: cloudinary.com/privacy
privacy.s5.title: 6. Data Retention Period
privacy.s5.p1: We retain your profile and warehouse data for the duration of your account's existence. Upon account deletion, data is promptly removed from Cloud Firestore and Cloudinary. Firebase Authentication logs may be retained by Google for an additional period according to their security retention policy.
privacy.s6.title: 7. Your Rights
privacy.s6.p1: Under GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.s6.item1: Access – right to know what personal data we hold about you
privacy.s6.item2: Rectification – right to update or correct your profile data at any time via the Profile page and edit your warehouse content
privacy.s6.item3: Erasure – you may delete warehouse items yourself or request deletion of your account and all data by writing to szymon.gross.dev@gmail.com
privacy.s6.item4: Restriction of processing & objection – right to limit or object to the processing of your data
privacy.s6.p2: To exercise your rights, contact: szymon.gross.dev@gmail.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the data protection supervisory authority (e.g., UODO in Poland).
privacy.s7.title: 8. Cookies and Local Storage
privacy.s7.text: Information about cookies and browser local storage can be found in our
privacy.s8.title: 9. Changes to this Privacy Policy
privacy.s8.p1: We will notify you of any changes by updating the date at the top of this page. Continued use of the Service after changes means acceptance of them.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1.title: 1. General Provisions
terms.s1.p1: These Terms of Service govern the use of the My warehouse web application available at warehouse.codefromheaven.dev (hereinafter: "Service"), operated by Szymon Gross (hereinafter: "Administrator"). Contact: szymon.gross.dev@gmail.com
terms.s1.p2: Using the Service means acceptance of these Terms.
terms.s2.title: 2. Definitions
terms.s2.item1: Service – the My warehouse web application available at warehouse.codefromheaven.dev, enabling cataloging and searching items within a hierarchy of warehouses, rooms, and boxes
terms.s2.item2: User – any natural person who accesses the Service or creates an account
terms.s2.item3: Account – an individual user profile in the Service to which their warehouses and items are assigned
terms.s3.title: 3. Terms of Use and Account Registration
terms.s3.item1: Using basic informational pages (Status, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Cookie Policy) does not require registration.
terms.s3.item2: To access warehouse management and item search features, you must create an Account (via email and password or Google Sign-In).
terms.s3.item3: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and not sharing your account with third parties.
terms.s3.item4: Providing false personal information during registration is prohibited.
terms.s4.title: 4. User Obligations
terms.s4.item1: Use the Service in accordance with applicable laws and good practices
terms.s4.item2: Refrain from attempts to breach system security or gain unauthorized access to other Users' data
terms.s4.item3: Refrain from uploading unlawful content or infringing on third-party rights in warehouse item names, descriptions, or profile data
terms.s_vault.title: 5. Cryptographic Security, Privacy & Recovery Key
terms.s_vault.p1: The Service operates on a strict Zero-Knowledge architecture to protect the confidentiality of your stored inventory:
terms.s_vault.item1: Sole Ownership & Confidentiality – All cataloged items, room names, and box descriptions remain your exclusive property and are encrypted on your device prior to cloud transmission.
terms.s_vault.item2: Responsibility for PIN and Recovery Key – You are exclusively responsible for safeguarding your master password, 4-digit PIN, and Emergency Recovery Key. Because the Administrator holds no backdoors or decryption keys, if both credentials/PIN and Recovery Key are lost, retrieving encrypted data is mathematically impossible and the Administrator bears no liability.
terms.s5.title: 6. Uploaded Images and Graphic Files
terms.s5.p1: The Service allows Users to voluntarily upload images (e.g., a profile picture). Uploaded graphic files are automatically optimized and stored in external cloud infrastructure provided by Cloudinary (Cloudinary Ltd.), while a reference link (URL) to the file is stored in the Service's database (Cloud Firestore).
terms.s5.item1: The User represents and warrants that they hold full rights to any uploaded images and that publishing them does not infringe copyright, personal rights, or the likeness of third parties.
terms.s5.item2: By uploading an image, the User grants the Administrator a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to store, technically process (crop, compress, convert format), and display the image within the Service's functionality for as long as the feature is used.
terms.s5.item3: The Administrator reserves the right to immediately remove any image that violates applicable laws, good practices, or these Terms.
terms.s6.title: 7. Administrator's Rights
terms.s6.p1: The Administrator reserves the right to:
terms.s6.item1: Block, archive, or delete accounts of users who violate these Terms
terms.s6.item2: Perform technical maintenance resulting in temporary unavailability of the Service
terms.s6.item3: Modify features, interface, and functionality of the Service
terms.s7.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
terms.s7.item1: The Service is provided free of charge, "as is", without any warranties of uninterrupted availability.
terms.s7.item2: The Administrator is not liable for interruptions in operation caused by force majeure or technical issues with external infrastructure providers (e.g., Google Firebase, Cloudinary).
terms.s7.item3: The Administrator is not responsible for the actual physical state of the User's inventory or for damages resulting from improper use of the Service by Users or for content and graphic materials uploaded by them.
terms.s8.title: 9. Complaints
terms.s8.p1: Any complaints regarding the operation of the Service may be sent to: szymon.gross.dev@gmail.com. We will process complaints within 14 days.
terms.s9.title: 10. Contact
terms.s9.p1: For matters related to these Terms, please contact: szymon.gross.dev@gmail.com
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s1.title: 1. What are cookies and localStorage?
cookies.s1.p1: Cookies are small text files saved on your device by the browser. localStorage and IndexedDB are mechanisms for storing data directly in the browser without an expiry date. Both mechanisms are used in the Service exclusively for technical purposes necessary for authentication and remembering interface preferences.
cookies.s2.title: 2. What cookies and localStorage keys we use
cookies.s2.p1: We use only necessary cookies and localStorage data – no advertising tracking or profiling.

vault.title: Zero-Knowledge Encryption
vault.subtitle: Your inventory is encrypted directly on your device using AES-256-GCM. Cloud administrators and hackers cannot read what items or rooms you have in your place.
vault.status.cardDesc: All items, rooms, and boxes are client-side encrypted before syncing to the cloud.
vault.pin.title: 4-Digit PIN
vault.pin.desc: Quick numeric PIN to unlock your vault without typing your master password, also used for Google SSO.
vault.pin.removeConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove your quick unlock PIN?
vault.recovery.title: Emergency Recovery Key
vault.recovery.desc: If you forget your password or PIN, this recovery key is the only way to recover your data. Keep it safe.
vault.recovery.warningText: Store this key safely in a password manager or physical vault. We cannot restore your items without it.
vault.inspect.title: Cloud Database Inspector
vault.inspect.desc: Verify the exact raw JSON stored in Google Firestore. Proves administrators cannot read your items.
vault.inspect.unencryptedNotice: Legacy unencrypted data. Will be encrypted automatically on your next save.

vault.badge.tooltip: Protected with AES-256-GCM. Decrypted only in your browser memory.

vault.resetAll.title: Reset Warehouse & Encryption Data
vault.resetAll.desc: Permanently deletes all warehouses, rooms, boxes, items, and encryption keys (PIN, salt, and metadata). This action cannot be undone.

vault.resetAll.success: All warehouse and encryption data have been successfully deleted.
